label: H.R. 9611

latest_action.text: Ordered to be Reported (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 20 - 16.

selection.reason: Impact scored and summarised by Gemini.

summary: H.R. 9611, the Less Bureaucracy, Better Higher Education Act, moves specific postsecondary education programs, funding, and personnel from the Department of Education to the Department of Labor's Employment and Training Administration. It also completely repeals four specific education programs and requires the Office of Management and Budget to ensure the transfer does not cause a net increase in federal full-time equivalent employees.

affected_groups.effect: Certain personnel, assets, and unexpended funds are transferred from the Department of Education to the Department of Labor's Employment and Training Administration.
affected_groups.group: Department of Education and Department of Labor personnel

affected_groups.effect: Individuals and entities involved in the Leveraging Educational Assistance Partnership Program, Robert C. Byrd Honors Scholarship Program, College Access Challenge Grant Program, and Project GRAD program lose these programs due to their repeal.
affected_groups.group: Participants and administrators of repealed programs

affected_groups.effect: Programs such as TRIO, HBCU programs, and HSI-STEM programs are managed by the Department of Labor instead of the Department of Education.
affected_groups.group: Participants and administrators of transferred programs

key_provisions: Transfers various postsecondary education functions, including TRIO programs, minority-serving institution programs, and the Fund for the Improvement of Postsecondary Education, from the Department of Education to the Department of Labor's Employment and Training Administration.

Repeals four programs: the Leveraging Educational Assistance Partnership Program, the Robert C. Byrd Honors Scholarship Program, the College Access Challenge Grant Program, and the Project GRAD program.
Transfers all related personnel, assets, liabilities, contracts, property, records, and unexpended appropriations associated with the moved functions to the Secretary of Labor.

Mandates that the Director of the Office of Management and Budget ensure no net increase in full-time equivalent employees at the affected federal agencies and certify compliance to specified congressional committees.
Protects ongoing legal suits, pending proceedings, and benefit applications from being disrupted by the transfer.
Sets the effective date for the act and its amendments to take effect 6 months after enactment, while allowing early implementation and transition actions.

summary_detail.plain_summary: H.R. 9611, the Less Bureaucracy, Better Higher Education Act, moves specific postsecondary education programs, funding, and personnel from the Department of Education to the Department of Labor's Employment and Training Administration. It also completely repeals four specific education programs and requires the Office of Management and Budget to ensure the transfer does not cause a net increase in federal full-time equivalent employees.
summary_detail.significance: The bill shifts administrative control and oversight of numerous federal postsecondary education programs and funding streams from one cabinet-level department to another, permanently eliminates four distinct higher education programs, and restricts overall federal personnel growth related to the reorganization.
